title: The verifier's ballot admission under a rolling definition (definition version 7, electorate_mode 2; ballot version 5): definitions, boards and pinned panels beside the group registry's events and the registration time, with the rows 3.2, 5.1 to 5.5 and 5.7 and the report's ballots
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/verifier-ballots-v5-vectors.py, from ballot-v5-records-vectors.py, verifier-ceremony-vectors.py, verifier-ballots-vectors.py and rolling-electorate-vectors.py (independent Python implementations; every step root is rebuilt there from the listed groups' events); membership proofs by packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-proofs.mjs, run outside the workspace with Semaphore 4.14.3's depth-32 circuit artifacts and snarkjs 0.7.5, whose groth16.verify gives every pairing verdict on the signals derived here from each record

cases.description: A sealed rolling poll without an author panel (pick one of three, pick up to two of four, pick exactly one of two); seat 4 sends nothing, so seats 1 to 3 are registered. On the board path: the transcript, five admitted ballots (a member who joined during the poll at step N0, an opening member at N0 − 1 and her re-vote at N0 + 1, tier 2's member in cell 1, a member added during the poll at the step whose boundary is closes_at), a ballot of each admission failure (another election's, cell 2, an author half the poll has no panel for, a share hash at seat 4, steps before registration, after close, with no live member and 2³² − 1, a step relabelled, a step relabelled to one with the same root, a proof against another step's root, a fixed poll's scope, a vote of 2, question 1 over its maximum, version 4's statement), two records that don't decode, a byte-identical repeat of the first ballot and a copy with its proof negated.

The same poll's ballots by the board's RollingBallotSubmitted (contract-event version 13), each with the root its submitter supplied: step N0's ballot with step N0's root (admitted), step N0 − 1's with step N0's root (root-step-mismatch), the re-vote at N0 + 1 with step N0 + 2's root, the same tree's (admitted: the supplied root is compared with the step's root, not its number), a board-path copy of the first (a repeat), tier 2's ballot boarded after close (window-after-close), a step before registration (root-step-range, before the supplied root is read), a relabelled step with that step's own root (membership-proof), the close step's ballot at closes_at (admitted) and a second event of the first ballot (a repeat).

Ballots by the board's RelayedRollingBallotSubmitted beside the board path: step N0 − 1's ballot with step N0's root is rejected (root-step-mismatch) before it could be set aside; tier 2's with its step's root passes 5.1 to 5.4 and is set aside until 4.5 proves its stamp, so 5.5 and 5.7 are unverifiable at it and a later copy of the board's first ballot is only a candidate repeat; another election's ballot is still rejected.
The transcript and no ballot: 5.1 to 5.5 and 5.7 pass, with nothing admitted.
